description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate from SQL Server to Managed Identity Based Azure SQL
tasks.requirements: Replace the local SQL Server (LocalDB) connection with Azure SQL Database. Use Managed Identity for authentication instead of connection string credentials. Update Entity Framework configuration and connection string handling accordingly.

tasks.description: Migrate from local file system to Azure Blob Storage
tasks.requirements: Replace local file system storage (Uploads/TeachingMaterials/) with Azure Blob Storage for teaching material uploads. Use Managed Identity for authentication to the storage account.

tasks.description: Migrate from MSMQ to Azure Service Bus
tasks.requirements: Replace MSMQ-based notification queuing with Azure Service Bus. The application currently uses MSMQ at queue path '.\Private$\ContosoUniversityNotifications' for notification processing. Migrate to Azure Service Bus queues with Managed Identity authentication.

tasks.description: Migrate from Plaintext Credentials to Secured Credentials protected by Managed Identity and Azure KeyVault
tasks.requirements: Replace plaintext connection strings and credentials in Web.config with Azure Key Vault references. Use Managed Identity to authenticate to Key Vault. Ensure all sensitive configuration values are stored securely.
Modernize local and network file I/O operations for cloud compatibility. Replace direct file system access patterns with cloud-compatible abstractions.
